arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cp /tmp/gen4.py tmp/gen4.py && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('/workspace/tmp/gen4.py').read()
old = """    if len(cl) <= maxcore:
        order = gen.exact_order(cl, final)
        if order is None:
            return None
    else:
        order = heuristic_order(cl, final)
        if order is None:
            return None"""
new = """    order = gen.find_order(cl, final, random.Random(rng.randrange(10**6)), tries=200)
    if order is None:
        return None"""
assert old in src, src[src.index('    if len(cl)'):src.index('    pool =')]
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('/workspace/tmp/gen4.py','w').write(src)
EOF
cp tmp/gen4.py /tmp/gen4.py && timeout 600 bash -c 'for s in 41 42 43 44; do python3 /tmp/gen4.py $s 30 || break; done'
